newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR HOLDS ABOVE SUPPORT AFTER BOUNCE.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR HOLDS ABOVE SUPPORT AFTER BOUNCE.

text.p: Trade buying interest prevented London's October white sugar contract from sliding through nearby support at $320 despite continued pressure from a mixed bag of sellers, traders said.
October hit a low of $320 earlier in the session after as trade, broker and commission house players joined to pummel the contract lower.
But it then bounced back as trade buyers were quick to emerge and pick up a bargain, with the turnaround also helped by more bullish sentiment in the New York market.
"There's good buying when it gets down there," said one trader.
Technical analysts said the outlook for October was turning more bearish although there was still cause for optimism while support held at $315.
At 1455 GMT October was up $1.10 at $321.20 with March up 90 cents at $321.00. December attracted very little trading interest with just five lots on the board.
Overall volume reached 1,571 lots which included a sprinkling of crossed trades.
Traders also reported the more active Oct/March spread bid at around $1.50.
In Paris volume stayed on the light side at 177 lots and nearby positions were tightly mixed.
October was up 40 cents at $321.40 and December up 50 cents at $319.00.
